Only 22% of 4,269 active remote listings disclose a USD salary figure — the other 78% stay silent on pay.

Loker Dollar's analysis of its own job data (queried 2026-10-13) finds 2,725 listings (64%) are open to applicants worldwide. High-end disclosed roles: OpenAI Data Scientist at USD 293,000–325,000/yr and Equinix Chief of Staff at USD 195,000–319,000/yr.

AI expertise appears in 12% of listings; communication is required in 39%. Both top-paying roles are technically intensive, so AI skill correlates with the top of the USD range.

The market moves fast: 1,205 listings were posted in the last 7 days.

Our take: skip the average-pay chase and target the transparent 22% where the range is explicit. Filter the board for "USD salary disclosed" and apply before the freshness window closes.
